subregion.name: The Cankered Ditches
subregion.summary: A dense network of silted irrigation gullies and stagnant drainage cuts.

subregion.name: The Carrion Granaries
subregion.summary: Crumbling storage barns and grain silos choked with damp mold.

subregion.name: The Compost Trenches
subregion.summary: Deep southern furrows packed with heaps of fermenting mulch and rot.

subregion.name: The Drowned Paddocks
subregion.summary: Sunken livestock enclosures and collapsed wooden fencing in the far southwest.

subregion.name: The Fallow Mire
subregion.summary: Waterlogged western tracts submerged under thick, putrid agricultural runoff.

subregion.name: The High Furrows
subregion.summary: Desiccated ridgelines and decaying crop rows along the higher northern reaches.

subregion.name: The Silt Terraces
subregion.summary: Eroded retaining walls and muddy tiers descending toward the east.

subregion.name: The Slough Pastures
subregion.summary: Low-lying southeastern grazing grounds mired in foul-smelling swamp muck.

subregion.name: The Withered Plots
subregion.summary: Northwestern planting squares overgrown with tangled, blackened vines.
